items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1962-04-11
items.q: And so, Shelley stands in, Jim, he said, I'm going to put you in this band.

ctx.x: Yeah. And so I took Jim in the band. Well, at that time, Jim wasn't playing with the Eurylipman. But Jim was wild, you know. He was wild. And so, Shelley stands in, Jim, he said, I'm going to put you in this band. But I'm going to lay me up to half. He's just ask your boss. Nobody explained and nothing would happen. Jim said, all right, all right, all right. You know how Jim is stuck. And he was so glad that he was in the tuxedo band. He didn't know what to do well. We took Jim and I broke Jim in. And boy, me and…
I heard something about him and Black Benny. Here, I'll get that. Yeah. They were real tight friends or something, huh?
